scripts.generate:types: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ../backend/Cargo.toml -p http-api --bin export-types -- ../frontend/src/api-types.ts && prettier --write src/api-types.ts
scripts.check:types: bash -o pipefail -c 'cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ../backend/Cargo.toml -p http-api --bin export-types -- /dev/stdout | prettier --parser typescript | diff - src/api-types.ts'
